WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT ci.country, r.raceId,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY ci.country, r.raceId
), country_avg AS (
  SELECT country,
         AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM per_race
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_minus_country_mean
FROM country_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Only countries with at least one race having constructor standings are returned; NULL country values, if any, form a country group. AVG ignores missing points or wins within each race and missing per-race averages across races.
